title: Coupling Report v1
description: Advisory coupling and stability report. Finding identities, trends, and package-level metrics with documented formulas.

flagged_count.description: Number of modules flagged as architecturally notable (D >= threshold).

flagged_identities.description: Sorted list of module names that are flagged.

graph_error.description: True when a graph build error or parse error prevents analysis.

trend.description: Trend comparison against a previous snapshot (only present when --trend-compare is used).

previous_flagged_count.description: Flagged count in the previous snapshot.

delta.description: Net change in flagged count (current - previous).

direction.description: improved = fewer flagged, regressed = more flagged, unchanged = same count.

previous_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp from the previous report.

added.description: Module identities that became flagged since the last snapshot.

removed.description: Module identities that were resolved since the last snapshot.

persistent.description: Module identities flagged in both the current and previous snapshots.

findings.description: All module findings, sorted by distance descending.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this report was generated.

module.description: Module name relative to root package (e.g. 'api.client').

ca.description: Afferent coupling: number of modules that depend on this module.

ce.description: Efferent coupling: number of modules this module depends on.

instability.description: I = Ce / (Ca + Ce). 0 = max stability, 1 = max instability.

distance.description: D = |A + I - 1|. Distance from the main sequence.

zone_of_pain.description: I < 0.3 and A < 0.3: stable, concrete, outgoing deps - rigid.

zone_of_uselessness.description: I > 0.7 and A > 0.7: unstable, abstract - no dependents.

advisory.description: Always true in v1. Findings are informational; graph/parse errors fail the command.

finding_id.description: Stable identifier: module name with hash suffix for deduplication across runs.

dependencies.description: Module names that this module imports (efferent targets).

dependents.description: Module names that import this module (afferent sources).
